narration:1:1510945001:0.text: As the Wildborn forces fall back, the battlefield begins to quiet...
narration:1:1510945001:0.source_cn: 随着雅库伯尔的撤退，战场上的混乱逐渐平息

narration:3:1510945002:0.text: But you can't stop thinking about what you saw during Merlin's battle with the Hunting Goddess—the radiant, eight-pointed star on her staff.
narration:3:1510945002:0.source_cn: 你不停回想着初代梅林面对狩猎神时所展现的印记，还有她法...
narration:3:1510945002:0.male: But you can't stop thinking about what you saw during Merlin's battle with the Hunting Goddess—the radiant, eight-pointed star on her staff.
narration:3:1510945002:0.female: But you can't stop thinking about what you saw during Merlin's battle with the Hunting Goddess—the radiant, eight-pointed star on her staff.

narration:4:1510945003:0.text: That was clearly Dura's sigil... a power only she herself could wield...
narration:4:1510945003:0.source_cn: 那分明是艾雅的印记，只有她本人才能展现的力量……
